A polgári repülés egészét veszélyben érző Winston Churchill kormányzati vizsgálatot indított a rejtélyes ügyben, mely hétköznapinak már csak azért sem nevezhető, mert mindkét tragédia áldozatainak testét különös, repülőgép-balesetek esetén felettébb szokatlan sebek borították...

programme.title: Dühöngő elemek
Weather Gone Viral 3
programme.desc: Az időjárás és a természet kiszámíthatatlan. Egyetlen pillanat alatt, minden figyelmeztetés nélkül képes felforgatni, sőt akár végveszélybe sodorni az ember életét. Legyen szó szél korbácsolta tengerről vagy aszály kiváltotta erdőtűzről, az elemekkel jobb nem ujjat húzni, mert az ember könnyen alulmaradhat a küzdelemben.

programme.title: Csempészek és határőrök: Karibi razziák
To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown: Season 1
programme.desc: Míg Puerto Ricóban egy drogcsempész banda több nagy erőkkel keresett, gyilkosságokkal is összefüggésbe hozható tagja is rendőrkézre kerül, a fajardói nyomozók hatalmas mennyiségű - mintegy 13 millió dollár értékű - kokaint foglalnak le egy oldalára fordult hajóról. A Virgin-szigetek környékén szintén nagy a forgalom a tengeren, egy éjszakai akció során több csempészhajóra is lecsapnak a hatóságok.

programme.title: Logisztika nagyban
Giant Logistics: Season 1
programme.desc: A bremerhaveni autóterminál a rekordok létesítménye: a gépkocsik ki- és berakodására szakosodott teherkikötő évente ezernél is több hajót szolgál ki, és mintegy 1.2 millió autó fordul meg a területén. A látványos filmben tarts velünk a kivételes logisztikai központ kulisszái mögé, és légy tanúja, hogy a digitalizáció miként segíti e gigantikus gépezet zökkenőmentes működtetését!

programme.title: Elhagyott építmények
Abandoned Engineering: Season 11
programme.desc: Egy katonai bázis Panamában az USA és a helyi drogkereskedők háborújának frontvonalán; egy kísérteties épület Varsó szívében, mely egy forradalmi mozgalom tagjainak börtönéül szolgált egykor; és egy gigantikus emlékmű Tunéziában, mely véres és erőszakos események tanúja volt a múltban. Megannyi elhagyott, összeomlás szélén álló építmény, mely most megvallja nekünk történelmi titkait.

programme.title: Kozmikus kilátások
Cosmic Vistas: Season 1
programme.desc: Az epizódból többek közt megtudjuk, hogy a Mars régen sokkal jobban hasonlított a mi kék bolygónkhoz, mint most, és hogy a legújabb kutatások szerint egykor gyűrű övezhette a Földet; de milyen új, számunkra is gyakorlati haszonnal bíró technológiákat köszönhetünk az űrkutatásnak?

programme.title: Kozmikus kilátások
Cosmic Vistas: Season 1
programme.desc: Az epizódban többek közt nyomába eredünk a Hold ismeretlen túlsó oldalán rejlő titkoknak, és megpróbáljuk rekonstruálni, hogy miként vált a Vénusz üde kék bolygóból izzó pokollá. De miféle különös világok sodródnak céltalanul az űr sötét végtelenjén át?

programme.title: A jövő mérnöktudománya: Tanulni a katasztrófákból
Engineering by Catastrophe: Season 1
programme.desc: Amikor a Világkereskedelmi Központ ikertornyai összedőltek, sokan azt gondolták, hogy a felhőkarcolók virágkora ezzel véget ért. Nos, a katasztrófa valóban fordulópontot jelentett - de egészen más jellegűt. A biztonsági előírások szigorításával és a szerencsétlenség tanulságainak nemzetközi megosztásával a szupermagas épületek iránti lelkesedés soha nem látott magasságokat ért el, minek következtében ma már világszerte 71 város büszkélkedik legalább egy 300 méternél magasabb felhőkarcolóval.

programme.title: A világ ízei Antoni Porowskival
No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski: Season 1
programme.desc: Antoni Porowski vendége ezúttal Florence Pugh, akivel Oxfordot, Londont és a yorkshire-i partvidéket járva fedezik fel a család kulináris hagyományait. Találkozásaik során a receptek mellett az ősökről és azok életéről is szó esik, és mindez, anélkül, hogy észrevenné, az eddiginél is szorosabbá teszi Florence családi kötődéseit.

programme.title: Elhagyott építmények
Abandoned Engineering: Season 9
programme.desc: Egy pornóbáró hedonista paradicsoma Horvátországban, melyet még egy atomháború kivédésre is alkalmassá tettek a tervezői; egy németországi katonai komplexum, mely bevonulhatott volna a világtörténelembe, ha - milliók életét megmentve - sikeres az itt végrehajtott puccs; és egy különös föld alatti létesítmény, melyet egy "őrült" angol polgármester építtetett a települése lakói számára. Megannyi elhagyott, összeomlás szélén álló építmény, mely most megvallja nekünk történelmi titkait.

programme.title: Az ókori Görögország elveszett kincsei
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece: Season 1
programme.desc: Nagy Sándor a történelem leghíresebb alakjai közé tartozik, a régészeknek mégis bőven van még mit kutatniuk vele kapcsolatban... Az izgalmas epizódban légy tanúja, amint a tudósok a görögországi Pella és a törökországi Epheszosz építészeti örökségét elemzik - és utazz el Egyiptomba is, ahol egy szörnyű sérülésnyomokat viselő csontváz kerül elő a föld alól. Nagy Sándor aranykorának árnyoldalai is voltak?

programme.title: Az ókori Görögország elveszett kincsei
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece: Season 1
programme.desc: A Szantorini szigetén tálható Akrotirit az 'Égei-tenger Pompeiijeként' is szokták emlegetni, és nem is alaptalanul, hiszen ezt a települést is egy vulkánkitörés hamuja temette maga alá. De miként? Hogyan került sor az emberi történelem egyik legpusztítóbb természeti katasztrófájára, melyet az általa kiváltott cunami csak még súlyosabbá tett? Tarts velünk egy izgalmas tudományos nyomozásra Szantorinire és a környező vizek mélyére!

programme.title: 1989: Amikor a mai világ született
1989: The Year That Made Us
programme.desc: 1989 - többek közt - a forradalmak és politikai földrengések éve volt. A hidegháború végét jelezve leomlott a berlini fal, Kelet-Európa addigi szocialista országai elindultak a demokratizálódás útján, a pekingi Tienanmen téren pedig Gorbacsov májusi látogatását követően sok százezres tüntetések kezdődtek rendszerváltást követelve.

programme.title: 1989: Amikor a mai világ született
1989: The Year That Made Us
programme.desc: Az 1980-as évek vége az újságírásban is szabadságot hozott. Ahol pedig addig is szabad volt, szabadosságot... Ebben az időben kezdtek gombamód szaporodni a pletyka- és bulvárlapok, melyekből a politikát egyre jobban kiszorították a balesetekről, botrányokról, szexafférokről és celebekről szóló szenzációhajhász híradások.

programme.title: 1989: Amikor a mai világ született
1989: The Year That Made Us
programme.desc: Mi a közös Batmanben, Bart Simpsonban és a kis a kis hableányban? Nos az, hogy valamennyien 1989-ben váltak milliók kedvenceivé. Az epizódban ismert televíziós és filmes személyiségek mondják el, hogy a három karakter kirobbanó sikere miként változtatta a show business hagyományos világát sokoldalú, sok milliárdos iparággá.

programme.title: 1989: Amikor a mai világ született
1989: The Year That Made Us
programme.desc: Az 1980-as évek vége nemcsak a politika, de a kultúra, és ezen belül a popkultúra területén is nagy változásokat hozott. Spike Lee Szemet szemért című filmje például elsöprő hatást gyakorolt a nézőkre, a Public Enemy provokatív szövegei pedig átformálták a hiphop zenét.

programme.title: 1989: Amikor a mai világ született
1989: The Year That Made Us
programme.desc: Akkor még nem tudtuk, de 1989-ben kezdetét vette a digitális korszak a világban. Ekkor álltak munkába az első modern GPS-műholdak a Föld körül, és ebben az évben debütált egy másik aprócska innováció is, melyet internetnek hívnak.

programme.title: 1989: Amikor a mai világ született
1989: The Year That Made Us
programme.desc: A Tienanmen téri tüntetésektől a berlini fal leomlásáig forradalmi események sora hatott a világra és a világ politikai-társadalmi berendezkedésére 1989-ben. A filmben díjnyertes újságírók, valamint James Baker, az USA korábbi külügyminisztere osztják meg gondolataikat a forradalmi időszakkal kapcsolatban.

programme.title: Légi balesetek - újrajátszva
Plane Crash Recreated: Season 2
programme.desc: A BOAC 712-es járata Zürichen keresztül Sydney-be indult volna a londoni Heathrow Repülőtérről, ám az utazás rémálommá változott: egy perccel a felszállás után a kettes számú hajtómű kigyulladt, és a lángok a szárnyra is átterjedtek. Cliff Taylor kapitány azonnal visszafordította a gépet, és hatalmas bravúrral sikerült is letennie azt a Heathrow betonjára, a landolást követő káoszban azonban öt ember az elharapózó tűz áldozatává vált. A megrázó epizód felidézi a legkritikusabb pillanatokat, és elénk tárja az esetet követően bevezetett szigorított tűzvédelmi és evakuációs szabályokat.

programme.title: Jeges pokol Norvégiában
Ice Road Rescue: Season 11
programme.desc: Jo Rogeren nem is lehetne nagyobb a nyomás, amikor Overhalla közelében egy balesetes teherautóhoz hívják, mely teljes egészében elzárja az észak-déli főutat, szó szerint kettévágva Norvégiát. Eközben az ország déli részén is zajlanak az események: egy éjszakára leparkolt teherautó csúszni kezd a jéggel borított lejtős úton, és csak a szerencsének köszönhető, hogy zuhan bele a közeli szakadékba - a benne alvó sofőrrel együtt.

programme.title: Monacói nagydíj: Egy legendás futam kulisszatitkai
Monaco Grand Prix: Backstages of a Mythical Race
programme.sub-title: Monacói nagydíj: Egy legendás futam kulisszatitkai
programme.desc: A televízión 90 országba közvetített és világszerte egymilliárd ember által figyelt Formula-1 monacói nagydíj az egyik legikonikus autóverseny a Földön. Ahhoz azonban, hogy a lebonyolítás biztonságos és zökkenőmentes legyen, az esemény előtt egy másik, hasonlóan látványos versenyre is sor kerül - a főszereplők azonban ezúttal mérnökök és technikusok, akiknek mindössze hét hét áll a rendelkezésére a versenypálya kialakítására Monaco szűk utcáin. A Nat Geo lebilincselő dokumentumfilmje látványos légifelvételek, háromdimenziós számítógépes animációk és mérnökökkel és versenyzőkkel készült interjúk segítségével mutatja be a motorok felbőgését megelőző izgalmas heteket.

programme.title: Kalózok: Legenda és valóság
Pirates: Behind the Legends: Compilation Season 1
programme.desc: Grace O'Malley-t "Írország kalózkirálynőjeként" is szokták emlegetni, és nem túlzás nélkül: a tengerészcsaládba született O'Malley ugyanis a nemi konvenciókra fittyet hányva a tenger és a szárazföld legtiszteltebb, legrettegettebb urává nőtte ki magát. Hasonló egyéniség volt Anne Bonny is, aki tisztes és biztonságos életet hátrahagyva állt tengeri rablónak szeretőjével, Calico Jackkel. A hamarosan hozzájuk csatlakozó Mary Readdel különös és félelmetes hírű triót alkottak - amíg el nem fogták és perbe nem fogták őket kalózkodásért.

programme.title: UFO-akták: Megnyílik az ismeretlen
UFOs: Investigating the Unknown 1
programme.desc: Az ufóészleléseknek se szeri, se száma: míg 1986-ban egy japán utasszállító pilótái látnak ismeretlen tárgyat a levegőben Alaszka felett, 2008-ban a chicagói O'Hare repülőtér közelében tűnik fel egy repülő csészealj. Az amerikai kormány mindazonáltal hosszú ideig homokba dugja a fejét és hallgatásba burkolódzik; az áttörést végül egy nagyszabású sajtókonferencia hozza meg, melyen szemtanúk, pilóták és kormányzati tisztségviselők osztják meg tapasztalataikat az idegenekkel kapcsolatban.

programme.title: Expedíció: Megmenteni a tengereket
Expedition: Saving Our Seas
programme.desc: A látványos különkiadás egy elhivatott kutatócsoport munkájába enged izgalmas bepillantást. Hőseink az Északi-sarktól az Antarktiszig új fajokat fedeznek fel, eddig ismeretlen ökoszisztémákat tanulmányoznak, valamint - a part menti közösségek tudását is felhasználva - megkísérlik megválaszolni a legfontosabb kérdést: napjaink változó körülményei között miként lehet megóvni a tengeri élővilágot a jövő számára?

programme.title: Rejtélyes történelem: Próféciák nyomában
Decoding History's Prophecies: Season 1
programme.sub-title: Megszállt nővér, gyógyító szekta, Morrigan istennő
programme.desc: A 17. századi Szicíliában egy szentéletű apácát megszálltak a sötét erők - vagy legalábbisőígy hitte, amikor a keze akaratán kívül egy rejtélyes, titkosírásos szöveget kezdett írni. Hogy mi állt az elátkozott üzenetben? Nos, ezt a kortársak és az egyház is nagyon szerették volna tudni, de a kód megfejtésére egészen 2017-ig kellett várni. Az ókori Görögországban ezalatt egy szekta a gyógyításairól és profetikus látomásairól lett híres, Írország ősi harcosait pedig egy alakváltó archaikus istenség, Morrigan segítette a csatában - valamikor régen, vagy csak a legendákban.

programme.title: Ezt ne próbáld ki! - Halálos mutatványok David Blaine-nel
David Blaine Do Not Attempt: Season 1
programme.desc: Az Északi-sarkvidék dermesztő, szélsőségesen hideg klímájú tájain a józan ész szerint egyetlen embernek se lenne szabad életben maradnia - sokan mégis dacolnak az elemekkel, sőt, olykor egyenesen az Istent kísértik elképesztő kunsztjaikkal. Az epizódban David Blaine az emberi szívósság, kitartás és alkalmazkodóképesség titkát igyekszik megfejteni...

programme.title: A bűn határai
Contraband Capture: Season 1
programme.desc: Ismét bebizonyosodik, hogy a floridai Fort Lauderdale nemcsak érkező, de induló állomása is az illegális kábítószereknek... Az izgalmas epizódban többek közt szemtanúi lehetünk, amint a parti őrség ügynökei feltartóztatnak és átkutatnak egy marihuánával megrakott, az USA-t elhagyni szándékozó hajót, és közelről figyelhetjük, ahogy a hatóságok fokozott ellenőrzés alá vonják a csempészek kedvelt útvonalaként elhíresült I-10 autópálya gulfporti szakaszát.

programme.title: A jövő mérnöktudománya: Tanulni a katasztrófákból
Engineering by Catastrophe: Season 1
programme.desc: Amikor a genovai Morandi híd összedőlt 2018-ban, egész Olaszország gyászba borult - a mérnökök pedig feltették maguknak a kérdést, hogy milyen változtatásokra van szükség a részükről napjaink megváltozott forgalmi terhelése és egyre szélsőségesebbé váló időjárása mellett. A török szakemberek szintén tanultak a múlt katasztrófáiból: a világ legnagyobb támaszközű hídjának tervezésekor egy olyan alkotás lebegett a szemük előtt, mely nemcsak a heves szélrohamoknak, de a földrengéseknek és az esetlegesen a pilonoknak ütköző hajóknak is ellenáll.

programme.title: A mérnöktudomány óriásai
Megabuilding Collection: Season 4
programme.sub-title: A Patrouille de France harci repülőgépei
programme.desc: A Francia Légierő műrepülő bemutató egysége (Patrouille de France) már több mint hét évtizede kápráztatja el a nagyszabású állami ünnepségek és katonai légiparádék közönségét. Ahhoz azonban, hogy a hajmeresztő kunsztok ne végződjenek tragédiával, magasan képzett legénységre és mozgékony, a legmodernebb technológiával felszerelt repülőgépekre van szükség. Üdvözlet a francia Top Gun lenyűgöző világában!

programme.title: Légikatasztrófák
Air Crash Investigation: Season 24
programme.desc: Amikor egy DC-9-es utasszállító repülőgép Milwaukee közelében néhány másodperccel a repülőtér betonjának elhagyása után a földbe csapódik, hatalmas a nyomás az okokat kereső baleseti kivizsgálókon. Az hamar világossá válik, hogy a típus hajtóművének egyik alkatrésze hajlamos a meghibásodásra, ám ez - mint utóbb kiderül - csak a történet egyik része.

programme.title: Légikatasztrófák
Air Crash Investigation: Season 24
programme.desc: Amikor egy Lockheed C-130 Hercules repülőgép lezuhan Ausztráliában egy bozóttűz oltása közben, a tragédia okait kereső nyomozóknak nincsen könnyű dolguk, mert a becsapódás helyszínén lángok pusztítanak - egy szemtanú által készített videó azonban arra utal, hogy az időjárás fontos szerepet játszhatott az események alakulásában.

programme.title: Légikatasztrófák
Air Crash Investigation: Season 24
programme.desc: Amikor két repülőgép összeütközik a levegőben Dél-Németország felett, mindkét jármű azonnal darabokra szakad a becsapódás erejétől - ez nem is kérdés, hisz számtalan földi szemtanúja van a tragédiának. Az viszont annál érthetetlenebb, hogy mit keresett két repülőgép egyszerre ugyanabban a magasságban. Mi történt azokkal a szofisztikált és eddig tökéletesen megbízhatónak gondolt biztonsági rendszerekkel, melyek a levegőben való ütközéseket hivatottak megelőzni?

programme.title: Garázs varázs
Car SOS: Season 14
programme.desc: Timékre pályafutásuk egyik legnehezebb küldetése vár: ki kell csempészniük gazdája garázsából egy Frogeye Sprite sportkocsit, hogy titokban, rekordidő alatt felújítsák azt. Az autó egykor John szeme fénye volt, családi elfoglaltságai miatt azonban immár évtizedek óta nem tud foglalkozni vele, így a matuzsálem mára kritikus állapotba került: a karosszéria csupa rozsda, a motor működésképtelen, a váltó teljes felújításra szorul. A fiúk mindent megtesznek a roncshalmaz újjávarázslásáért, ám ha a tulajdonosnak feltűnik a garázskulcsok eltűnése, lebuknak, mielőtt elkészül a csoda...

programme.title: Élet Sydney repülőterén
Inside Sydney Airport: Season 1
programme.desc: Sydney repülőtere város a városban, ahol elkötelezett, magasan képzett alkalmazottak ezrei dolgoznak a zökkenőmentes működésért és a menetrend betartásáért. Így aztán ebben a jól szervezett komplexumban az se okoz gondot, ha egy futópályára éjfélkor kell a jeleket felfesteni; ha egy karbantartó munkás beszorul a liftbe; vagy ha egy repülőgépen a landolást követően tűz ki, a fedélzeten tartózkodó több száz utas életét közvetlen veszélybe sodorva...

programme.title: Élet Sydney repülőterén
Inside Sydney Airport: Season 1
programme.desc: Karácsonykor a vakációzni induló családoknak köszönhetően a szokottnál is nagyobb a forgalom Sydney repülőterén, így rosszabbkor nem is üthetett volna be a baj: az egyik érkező repülőgépen gyanús fehér port találnak a biztonsági szolgálat emberei, és nem kizárt, hogy a hírhedt anthraxról van szó.

programme.title: A jövő mérnöktudománya: Tanulni a katasztrófákból
Engineering by Catastrophe: Season 1
programme.desc: A széndioxid-kibocsátás nélkül elektromos áramot termelő atomerőművek a klímaváltozás elleni harc kulcsfontosságú eszközei - még ha a lakosság egy része veszélyesnek is tartja őket. A valóság azonban az, hogy az atomenergia az áramtermelés egyik legbiztonságosabb formája, nem kis részben a múltbeli katasztrófák tanulságainak köszönhetően. Az izgalmas epizód Csernobiltől Fukushimáig és Three Mile Island-ig három nagy baleset okait veszi górcső alá - hogy a jövőben ne fordulhassanak elő hasonló incidensek.

programme.title: A világ ízei Antoni Porowskival
No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski: Season 1
programme.desc: Antoni Porowski ezúttal Issa Rae színésznőt kíséri el apja szülőföldjére. Issa Szenegálban nemcsak az ősei konyháját ismeri meg, de izgalmas családi történeteket is hall erős nőkről és királyi felmenőkről, és az utazás végére azt is megtalálja, amit a legjobban keresett ebben az ismerős-ismeretlen afrikai országban: a saját identitását.

programme.title: Expedíció: Megmenteni a tengereket
Expedition: Saving Our Seas
programme.desc: A látványos különkiadás egy elhivatott kutatócsoport munkájába enged izgalmas bepillantást. Hőseink az Északi-sarktól az Antarktiszig új fajokat fedeznek fel, eddig ismeretlen ökoszisztémákat tanulmányoznak, valamint - a part menti közösségek tudását is felhasználva - megkísérlik megválaszolni a legfontosabb kérdést: napjaink változó körülményei között miként lehet megóvni a tengeri élővilágot a jövő számára?

programme.title: Tényleg így készül?!
Food Factory 1
programme.desc: A filmből többek közt megtudjuk, hogy miként alakítja át a hagyományos tojástermelést a gépesítés és az automatizálás; és hogy hogyan lehet óránként 28 ezer tökéletes tortillát készíteni.

programme.title: Tényleg így készül?!
Food Factory 1
programme.desc: A filmből többek közt megtudjuk, hogy miként lehet óránként 240 flakon tejszínhab spray-t előállítani; és hogy miért szükséges vákuum a tökéletes nyalóka elkészítéséhez.

programme.title: Az ókori Görögország elveszett kincsei
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece: Season 1
programme.desc: A trójai háború az emberiség leghíresebb történetei közé tartozik. Vajon mi igaz a legendából, és napjaink legújabb tudományos eredményei mit árulnak el az a mesét inspiráló valós történelmi eseményekről? Nyomozz velünk egy több ezer éves történet részletei után a legmodernebb technológia segítségével!

programme.title: Az ókori Görögország elveszett kincsei
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece: Season 1
programme.desc: A Szantorini szigetén tálható Akrotirit az 'Égei-tenger Pompeiijeként' is szokták emlegetni, és nem is alaptalanul, hiszen ezt a települést is egy vulkánkitörés hamuja temette maga alá. De miként? Hogyan került sor az emberi történelem egyik legpusztítóbb természeti katasztrófájára, melyet az általa kiváltott cunami csak még súlyosabbá tett? Tarts velünk egy izgalmas tudományos nyomozásra Szantorinire és a környező vizek mélyére!

programme.title: Az ókori Görögország elveszett kincsei
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece: Season 1
programme.desc: A Parthenon a történelem egyik legikonikusabb épülete. Hogyan épült, mit mesél Athén az ókori Görögországon belül betöltött szerepéről, és - ami talán a legaktuálisabb - miként lehetne megmenteni a jövő számára? Nyomozz velünk a Parthenon és az őt emelő kivételes civilizáció titkai után!

programme.title: Az ókori Görögország elveszett kincsei
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece: Season 1
programme.desc: Minósz király és a vérengző Minótaurosz legendája az emberiség legijesztőbb történetei közé tartozik. Vajon mi ihlette ezt a kegyetlen históriát, kik voltak a minósziak, akiknek az elméjéből kipattant? Az epizódban egy tudóscsapat a régészet eszközeivel igyekszik megválaszolni az izgalmas kérdéseket...

The Creature Cases
programme.desc: (A zavarbaejtő borz balhé - 02. évad/10. rész, 2023.) "A The Wally Bungler Show"-ban Sam és Kit felidézik legelső ügyüket: amikor eltűnik egy borz, prérifarkas barátja teljesen kétségbeesik.

Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.desc: גרג ולוקאס פוגשים משפחה שמכניסה זוחל ראשון לבית, ומבקשת מתחם מחייה בסגנון סלון מערבי. במקביל, טיירון, ג'ייסון, כריס ולוקאס מתחרים ביצירת המם הכי מצחיק.

programme.title: צדק מחוספס 2
programme.desc: השוטרים מתעמתים עם ציידי דובים כאשר חשוד בשכרות נלקח לכלא. בנוסף, גבר עם צו מעצר נתפס מקיים יחסי מין עם אישה.

programme.title: אקווריומים מטורפים 5
programme.desc: שיחה מכוכב ה-NBA דווייט הווארד שולחת את הצמד ליוסטון. אך הווארד לא רק רוצה אקווריום, הוא גם רוצה בית חדש עבור הנחשים שלו.

programme.title: משטרת בעלי החיים, פילדלפיה 12
programme.desc: פרק מיוחד חושף את מפעלי הגורים של אמריקה: כלביות גידול מסחריות בהן הסטנדרטים גרועים.

programme.title: משטרת בעלי החיים, פילדלפיה 12
programme.desc: כלב מגיע אל הצוות עם פרווה ארוכה כל כך שהוא בקושי יכול לראות, ואדם חשוד באלימות כלפי שלושה חתולים.

programme.title: בני אלסקה האחרונים
programme.desc: סתיו בשמורת הבר הלאומית הארקטית וזאת אומרת שהקריבו נודדים. בנוסף לכך, דוב הנורס בקתה ויוצר חוסר במזון.

programme.title: החיים בטבע באלסקה 2
programme.desc: ריאליטי. פרק 5: בואו אל לב ערבות אלסקה עם משפחת בראון, המונה שבעה ילדים. בני המשפחה חיים הרחק מהציוויליזציה וזקוקים זה לזה כדי לשרוד במרחבי הטבע.

programme.title: החתול שלי מהגיהנום 7
programme.desc: ג'קסון עושה את דרכו לברוקלין, שם פוגש זוג שמתמודד עם ריב מתמשך בין שני החתולים שלהם.

programme.title: פיטבול ושחרור על-תנאי 4
programme.desc: בקשת עזרה הופכת לטרגית כאשר טיה מסייעת לגבר לטפל בשני כלבים שהוא הציל. לאחר מכן, מתנדב בוילאלובוס מתנדב לאמץ כלב עם עבר יוצא דופן.

programme.title: פיטבול ושחרור על-תנאי 4
programme.desc: טיה, טניה ורנדי, אסיר משוחרר טרי, ממהרים לנאשוויל כדי להציל כלב מ"תא הנידונים למוות". בהיעדרה של טיה, מריה נאבקת בסערה המאיימת להציף את וילאלובוס.

programme.title: פיטבול ושחרור על-תנאי 4
programme.desc: כלב נטוש בביצות מניע את טיאה ואת התאומים למשימת הצלה בסירה. לאחר מכן, הלחץ של איזון בין עבודה להורות מוציא אסיר צעיר על תנאי משליטה.

programme.title: החיים באוניברסיטה לווטרינריה
programme.desc: הלימודים בעיצומם ובעוד מספר חודשים ספורים הסטודנטים יהפכו לרופאים.

programme.title: החיים באוניברסיטה לווטרינריה
programme.desc: יום ההתאמות הגיע והמתח בשיאו ברחבי בית החולים. היום תלמידי השנה הרביעית יגלו, אם הם התקבלו לתוכנית התמחות או לא.

programme.title: ד"ר ג'ף: הווטרינר מהרי הרוקי 4
programme.desc: במרכז ההדרכה הבינלאומי, ד"ר ג'ף מטפל בכלב משוטט הסובל מרגל שבורה. בינתיים, הקטור שומר על הכלב של ד"ר ג'ף, פרד.

programme.title: ד"ר ג'ף: הווטרינר מהרי הרוקי 4
programme.desc: בדנוור, הווטרינרים מטפלים בחתול בשם ביירון, שירד במשקל באופן מסתורי. בנוסף, בר, הכלב, מטופל בפציעות לאחר שנפגע ממכונית.

programme.title: וואו! זו משפחת ארווין
programme.desc: תעודה. 11. לשחות עם מנטות: רוברט נוסע לשונית המחסום הגדולה על מנת לעזור במחקר של דגי מנטה ריי. בינתיים, הצוות בגן החיות מציל גור של וולבי המתקשה לשרוד.

programme.title: וואו! זו משפחת ארווין
programme.desc: תעודה. 12. שורטים את הלב של טרי: טרי נוכחת בבדיקה של צ'ארלי הטיגריס על מנת לראות אם הגידולים שלו הגיבו לטיפול בהצלחה. בינתיים, בינדי עוזרת לפתח חיסון בשביל עדן, השד הטסמני.

programme.title: האקווריום
programme.desc: באקווריום בג'ורג'יה, כל לידה, הטלת ביצה או בקיעה היא אירוע מיוחד לצוות. חוויות כאלה מעשירות את המבקרים ואת אנשי המקום.

programme.title: פיטבול ושחרור על-תנאי 8
programme.desc: טיה מנסה להציל כלב תועה, אך הפציעה ברגל מעכבת אותה. בינתיים, המשוחרר החדש מייק מתקשה לאזן בין העבודה ובין תפקידו כהורה.

programme.title: החתול שלי מהגיהנום 3
programme.desc: אישה וחברתה חולקות במשמורת על חתול מיילל וטורדני. זוג אחד מעוניין להקים משפחה, אך בני הזוג חוששים מהתנהגותו התוקפנית של חתולם.

programme.title: המאסטרים של בתי העץ 5
programme.desc: פיט והצוות מעניקים לזוג חובב ריגושים את בית העץ החלומי שלהם, הניצב בין שלושה עצי ארז עם מרפסת היקפית המספקת תצפית מרהיבה של 360 מעלות.

programme.title: המאסטרים של בתי העץ 5
programme.desc: פיט והחבורה שלו מבשלים בית עץ בחדר האוכל עבור מסעדה צרפתית. מוקף בשדות, המטרה היא להביא את אזור הכפר של פרובנס לאורחים.

programme.title: איך בעלי החיים עושים את זה?
programme.desc: מומחים בודקים כיצד דוב הנמלים אוכל כל כך מהר. וגם, לווייתן גדול-סנפיר יכול לשיר במשך ימים, אך כיצד הוא עושה זאת ללא מיתרי קול ומדוע?

programme.title: איך בעלי החיים עושים את זה?

programme.title: משלחת ביגפוט
programme.desc: קבוצה של מומחים החמושים בטכנולוגיה העדכנית ביותר מנסים לאתר את הביגפוט האגדי. החיפוש שלהם לוקח אותם בהתחלה ליערות של אורגון.

programme.title: האגדה של "כחול עמוק"
programme.desc: מומחי הכרישים, ברנדון מקמילאן וג'ימי פרטינגטון, שבים לאי גוואדלופ בחיפוש אחר "כחול עמוק", עמלץ ממין נקבה הגדול ביותר בעולם. האם יצליחו לפענח את התעלומה?

programme.title: חילוץ בטבע 3
programme.desc: בני משפחת רייני עוזרים למשפחה המתקשה לשרוד בביתם שעשוי מ-30,000 באלות של צמיגים. הם נאבקים במזיקים פולשניים, הצפות וקירות לא יציבים.

programme.title: פגוש את הפינגווינים
programme.desc: פינגווין עם פצע מסכן חיים מקבל טיפול, שניים מהפינגווינים מעורבים במריבה מכוערת, ואחד הוותיקים חוגג מאורע מיוחד!

programme.title: פגוש את הפינגווינים
programme.desc: בלואי, אפרוחית קטנה ונטושה בת 4 חודשים שוקלת קצת יותר מקילוגרם אחד, הצוות עושה כל שביכולתם אבל סיכויי ההצלחה אינם גבוהים.

programme.title: בית החיות

programme.title: החיים בטבע באלסקה 4

programme.title: איך בעלי החיים עושים את זה?
programme.desc: מדוע חתולי בית מתקשים לרדת מעצים, וכיצד התפתחו שני חתולי ביצות? וגם, מדוע עופות קיווי מטילות ביצים ענקיות ביחס לגודל שלהן?

programme.desc: כיצד זחלים הופכים לפרפרים יפהפיים בתוך הפקעת שלהם? וגם, מדוע לשון של חתול נראית כפי שהיא נראית? המומחים שלנו עונים על שאלות אלו ועוד!

programme.desc: כאשר האסקי עם פצע עמוק בצווארו מגיע למרכז לבעלי חיים בפנסלבניה הווטרינרית של המרכז, ד"ר רייצ'ל לי נחושה להציל אותו.

programme.title: דובאי הפראית

programme.desc: בראדלי ובילי בדרום קליפורניה בחיפוש אחר טורף על מפתיע. האופוסומים הזעירים האלה שולטים בטבע ביחס לגודלם.

programme.title: ענקים קטנים

programme.title: The Last Cowboy

When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines

With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Icon

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon

For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.desc: Ruth Galloway is a well-to-do socialite who's not quite as secure inside as she seems from the outside. When a young woman named Billy saves her life, Ruth decides to turn her mansion into a shelter for the city's homeless.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: In the series premiere of THE LAST ALASKANS, three families living in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge prepare for the upcoming winter due to arrive in just four weeks. It is September in Alaska, and Heimo and Edna Korth set out to hunt down the tail end of a caribou migration. Bob Harte arrives at his cabin to find it was ransacked by a young grizzly bear, destroying two years of his food supply, which ultimately forces Bob to fly his small single propeller plane to a tiny village located hundreds of miles away to resupply. The Lewis family of five arrives at the refuge with hope as signs of life have returned to the land surrounding their home after a wildfire forced most of the native animals to flee three years earlier. Once settled, Ray and his teenage daughters compete with hungry wolves to take down a moose in order to feed their family throughout the harsh winter. Later, both Heimo and Bob confront the personal tragedies that come with living in extreme isolation nearly 400 miles from civilization.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Scaled
programme.desc: Scaled is a documentary show following reptile-lover Greg West and his team, as they make custom terrariums and cages for reptile-owners across America. Those who are not fans of traditional fluffy pets want to create one-of-a-kind habitats for snakes, skinks, agamas or frogs. The unique ideas for creative design of Greg are turned into reality in the show. Meet these extraordinary animals and their owners, as the team of Cornel's World make their environment more special.

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Animal Planet's Rugged Justice follows the officers from Washington State's Department of Fish and Wildlife Law Enforcement as they guard the vast borders. It is an elite unit that protect people and wildlife, patrolling coastal areas, mountainous terrains and rugged roads of rainforests. Every day brings a new challenge, dispatchers receive around 25.000 calls annually, every of which requires prompt reaction.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Following the antics of two brothers-in-law as they run the largest aquarium manufacturing company in the nation, Tanked dunks viewers into the high-decibel, family-owned business of Acrylic Tank Manufacturing (ATM). Led by business partners, best friends and constant rivals Wayde King and Brett Raymer, this 13,000 square foot facility, located in Las Vegas, produces some of the most outrageous, larger-than-life and one-of-a-kind tanks for some of the most striking fish and clients around.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Viewers go behind the scenes at the largest aquarium in the Western Hemisphere - Atlanta's Georgia Aquarium. Georgia Aquarium, which plays a crucial role in aquatic conservation throughout the world, opens its doors to Animal Planet's global audiences with unprecedented access to the aquatic animals and inner-workings of the Western Hemisphere's largest aquarium in an all-new series, THE AQUARIUM. The series introduces and shares the stories of the amazing animals who call the 10 million gallons of water at the Georgia Aquarium home, including rescued southern sea otters, endangered African penguins, rescued California sea lions, and manta rays, among others. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Anais throws a party but no-one shows up as she has no friends or social skills. / Alan is so good-natured that Gumball feels compelled to make him lose his temper. / Things aren't going Gumball's way at school so he assumes there must be a Secret Society... / Gumball and Darwin want to see the scariest film of the year. / Gumball and Darwin hit snooze too many times on their alarm clock and miss the school-bus. / Things keep going missing in the house so it's up to Gumball and Darwin to find the culprit. / Gumball refuses to get out of bed because he is in a lousy mood. / Nicole arranges a playdate for Anais with the son of a classy lady she met at the supermarket.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin agree to do all of Tobias's chores in exchange for good points! Gumball and Darwin discover that Tobias is doing way better than them in an online game called Galatrek. Tobias admits he earns "good points" doing chores for his parents which he then exchanges for dollars to buy cool stuff for Galatrek. If Gumball and Darwin do Tobias' chores they can earn his "good points" and use them for Galatrek. Gumball and Darwin think they've hit the jackpot. But these "good points" may not be quite as good as Tobias claims...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: A documentary chronicling real life the adventures of one of the most deadliest professions in the world. Follow Alaskan crab fishermen as they face 40-foot waves and intense discomfort with freezing temperatures as they fish in the Bering sea. Sacrificing tooth and nail to catch the seasonal delicacies to later sell and trade on land. Witness the dangers these fisher men face as they battle against the sea, and experience how caution is a crucial part of staying alive.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Unique American reality series that follows a group of friends in Utah- David ''Heavy D'' Sparks, David ''Diesel Dave'' Kiley, and their crew at ''DieselSellerz'' who sell parts for diesel trucks and jeeps, repair and customize pickup trucks. They design and build some of the biggest and most amazing diesel powered vehicles you will ever see, and also do truck giveaways. Watch as they create these awesome masterpieces and enjoy all the crazy adventures they get into while doing it.

programme.title: Fast n' Loud
programme.desc: Fast N' Loud is a reality styled TV show featuring Richard Rawlings and his crew from the Dallas, Texas-based Gas Monkey Garage. For most people old rusty cars in garages or open spaces are nothing but junk, but not for these guys. For them it is a perfect chance to reconstruct such vehicles and make some money. The old run-down cars are restored flawlessly and are able to run steadily for the next 10 years for sure. Richard and his crew work really hard to make a name for themselves and have become a huge success thanks to their enormous talents.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.desc: Crimes Gone Viral explores the riveting stories behind shocking crimes caught on camera that gain viral fame on the internet. From business security cameras to home surveillance systems and cell phone cameras, someone is almost always watching. Gripping clips of kidnappings, break-ins, wild car chases, violent road rage incidents and other crimes rack up millions of views. But CRIMES GONE VIRAL goes beyond the jaw-dropping footage to tell the full story. This series features compelling interviews and behind-the-scenes information of some of the internet's most viral crime clips.

programme.title: High Speed Chase
programme.desc: In Utah, a chance encounter escalates from death threats in a parking lot to a demolition derby on the highway. In Illinois, a 100 mile long chase ends with a $250,000 drug bust. And in Georgia, deputies call time on one drivers run from the law.

programme.title: High Speed Chase
programme.desc: In Georgia, a chase crosses multiple counties and gets very close to the Florida/Georgia state line before a PIT maneuver ends the 150 mile pursuit. And in rural Texas, a thief leads cops through dusty roads, through water and into the woods in the dead of night.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Arturo is a good friend of the shop, and his classic Nova will be a monster, with a rebuilt supercharged 6.2 LS, plus upgrades to the chassis and brakes to handle the massive increase in power. Also, the crew revives a classic 1924 LaFrance fire truck for the nearby Cedar Hill Fire Department and takes it for a spin at a parade downtown.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud: Demolition Theater
programme.desc: A spin-off of the original ''Fast N' Loud'' series, in which Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman, crew of the Gas Monkey Garage check out craziest viral videos and epic fails. Here, you will have a chance to see wild and dangerous stunts, drivers unable to control their vehicles, freak accidents, awesome pranks,... and hear hilarious comments from our hosts. The show also welcomes ''special'' guests - people featured in the actual videos.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: G.A.S. Extreme Customs
programme.desc: Join boss Beau Boeckman and the crew from Galpin Auto Services as they resurrect some of the most iconic machines of automotive history and keep the flag flying for car culture. Aided by custom car experts Dave Shuten and 'Mad Mike' Martin, Beau transforms these neglected and decrepit automobiles into objects of beauty and art. Episodes see the team bring to life a unique Pantera that was hot-rodded by Carroll Shelby; beef up a '68 Charger with some up-to-date mechanics; make-over a couple of Hollywood star vehicles built by legendary George Barris; and re-build a '72 Mach-1 Mustang resto-mod for NASCAR superstar Joey Logano.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: A visit to a popular car show inspires Mike to put on his own in an attempt to promote his expanding business. James takes a punt on a BMW convertible with a broken roof and there's a major breakthrough in the hunt for new premises for the business.

programme.title: Trans Am
programme.desc: For decades, no other muscle car ruled the roads like the Trans Am. So when the automotive icon fell into oblivion, car savants Scott and Tod Warmack risked everything to acquire the rights in an attempt to resurrect the legendary brand from extinction. Now, builder Scott and businessman Tod are giving the greenlight to the Trans Am legacy by restoring old muscle cars and building new ones to breathe life back into American muscle and put the beloved car back on the pavement.

programme.title: American Chopper: Senior vs Junior
programme.desc: "American Chopper" is back ... sort of. After that popular motorcycle-building reality series crashed after six seasons amidst a Teutul family feud, Paul Sr. and son Paul Jr. return as competitors. Senior and his staff continue their work at Orange County Choppers, while Junior launches Paul Jr. Designs across the street from OCC's original site. Not only that, but Paulie twists the knife even more by hiring former OCC employees, including his brother Mikey, Vinnie DiMartino, Robert "Nub" Colard and Joe Puliafico. With the battle lines drawn, who will survive by designing and building the most innovative choppers?

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: The owner, Sanders, has had some bad luck with this '56 Bel Air going from shop to shop, and he still doesn't have his family dream car ready. Shorty's shop is the last stop. Joel and Shorty make sure this car is ready for the road. The guys also C notch an '84 Silverado and update it for a potential sale.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Paul decides to take one of his prized '59s and go full lowrider with hydraulics and a full custom lowrider paint job. Shorty's wife Lupe has a '92 Mustang GT 5.0, and Shorty has a "honey do" list to get this car back to its original glory.

programme.title: One Man Army
programme.desc: What do you get when you pit elite military, extreme sports and law enforcement operatives against one another? ONE MAN ARMY, a competition series which sees the toughest of the tough go head to head in events that would sideline regular contestants in an instant. Hosted by Mykel Hawke, U.S. Army Special Forces veteran and former Green Beret, ONE MAN ARMY makes its world premiere on Discovery Channel Wednesday, July 13 from 10-11PM ET/PT. In the dangerous, unpredictable world of covert operations, counterterrorism, elite combat and law enforcement, only the fastest, strongest and smartest survive. In each episode of ONE MAN ARMY, Hawke (Man, Woman Wild) puts four of the deadliest humans in America through three separate challenges of speed, strength and intelligence. One by one, they are eliminated until one stands alone as the winner of both a $10,000 prize and the title of ONE MAN ARMY. Each episode will introduce four new competitors, featuring men from the Navy Seals (including a former Seal Team 6 member), Marines, Air Force, Army, U.S. Marshals Service, SWAT and other law enforcement agencies, as well as top fighters from MMA and other extreme sports. Along the way, we meet each competitor to learn their history, motivation and why their specific training either gives them a leg up or is a liability in each of the challenges.

programme.title: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
programme.desc: Reality series, a spin-off of ''Gold Rush'', that follows Dave Turin, who was in the Todd Hoffman's crew, as he looks to start new mining operations at disused gold mines in the Western United States. "Dozer Dave" and his team - Jason Sanchez, Chris Taylor, Casey Morgan, Nathan Clark and Jesse Goins return to gold mining, searching for lost and abandoned mines to resurrect, and chasing for the gold the old-timers left behind.

programme.title: Expedition Files
programme.desc: Josh Gates investigates Jim Morrison's death, a "mermaid" in a Japanese temple and an alien abduction claim. From a rock legend's mysterious disappearance, to a bizarrely preserved creature, and a U.S. Airman's extraterrestrial encounter, he seeks the truth behind these unexplained stories.

programme.title: Mystery Of Blind Frog Ranch
programme.desc: There are some places on earth where the land just seems different, and Blind Frog Ranch in eastern Utah is one of those places. Locals say the land is cursed. That it's trying to hold on to something. From Aztec treasure to caverns of gold and silver to lost Mormon mines, legends surround Duane Ollinger's 160-acre ranch in Utah's Uintah Basin. But Duane isn't concerned with the lore. After discovering a system of seven underground caves that run through his property, he is singularly focused on finding what's hidden in them – no matter what the cost.

programme.title: King Tut 100 Year Anniversary Special
programme.desc: Narrated by Josh Gates, the world's leading Egyptologists are on a quest to uncover the secrets of Howard Carter's history-making discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb on the 100th Anniversary of the greatest archaeological find in history.

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs
programme.desc: Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: The world's toughest treasure hunters push their bodies and bank accounts to the limit on a quest to strike it rich, hunting the legendary Queen of Gems - Opal. Australia produces more than 90% of the world's opals. Hidden beneath outback desert plains lies a hidden bounty, 30 million years in the making, waiting to be discovered. Opals are one of the most valuable gemstones on the planet – one stone alone can fetch a million dollars – and it's the dream of striking it rich that drives these crews to push their bodies and bank accounts to breaking point.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: A documentary chronicling real life the adventures of one of the most deadliest professions in the world. Follow Alaskan crab fishermen as they face 40-foot waves and intense discomfort with freezing temperatures as they fish in the Bering sea. Sacrificing tooth and nail to catch the seasonal delicacies to later sell and trade on land. Witness the dangers these fisher men face as they battle against the sea, and experience how caution is a crucial part of staying alive.

programme.title: Guardians Of the Glades
programme.desc: Follow snake hunter Dusty "The Wildman" Crum and his team - Brittany, swamp expert Jay, wildlife specialist Gary, survivalist Tom and Florida's number one python-hunting dog Riley, as they hunt down fearsome snake that's terrorizing Everglades - swamps located on the southernmost tip of Florida, called the Burmese python. This notorious predators that escaped captivity after Hurricane Andrew, quickly multiplied after breeding and feeding on the animals in the Glades. Dusty will take matters into his own hands as he tries to stop these deadly creatures from further destroying the ecosystem.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making divine chocolate treats for her daughter, Paige, to share with her school friends, and she's sneaking in a few for her husband, Ladd, while she's at it. There are adorable Classic Chocolate Cups decorated with homemade Sugared Orange Peels and a bunch of store-bought toppings. Ree shows her love with over-the-top Love and Kisses Cookies and the easiest Chipotle Fudge, and double-dipped Cookies and Cream Marshmallow Treats are made with oodles of chocolate and lots of fun.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Kids Sweets Showdown
programme.desc: Nearly all kids love to eat sweet treats, but how many can make them? In this cooking competition series hosted by Alisson Sweeney, Sharone Hakman and Harley Morenstein, young bakers are invited to showcase their culinary talents for a slice of a hefty $10,000 cash prize. Two pairs of kids go head to head in a primary baking competition, whilst there are also "sugar rush" challenges, where the young bakers have a limited amount of time to create something delicious. Each of the dishes are judged and scored, with the best performing duo taking home the cash.

The home's charming trellis, however, stays put and makes the finished project a geometric masterpiece.

programme.title: Pool Kings
programme.desc: Well-do-to clients wishing for their own slice of paradise in their very back yard. Sounds like a job for the pool kings. Dramatic, in-ground pools with water features, decorative extras, outdoor kitchens and yes, even mini water parks. Innovative and outlandish designs, courtesy of California Pools, one of the largest pool builders in the U.S, and Tennessee-based Peek Pools & Spas bring the latest trends and modern features of back yard pools.

programme.title: Vacation House for Free
programme.desc: Matt Blashaw realizes couples' wishes to own a vacation home mortgage free. The secret? The couple rents out the renovated home for maximum income part of the year, covering all their annual expenses. For the rest of the year they live in a Vacation House for Free!
